subject: Embeddings storage & governance — pilot commercials and scope
messages:
From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
To: emma@pinecone.io, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Embeddings storage & governance — pilot commercials and scope

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday. We discussed a 6-week pilot for embeddings persistence (cold tier fallback to object storage) and wanted to put scope + asks in one place so we can align on commercials. High-level asks from our side: 

- Pilot scope: 6 weeks, up to 50M vectors (1536-dim), live queries + nightly reindexing from our S3 ingest.
- Performance SLO: p50 <= 80ms for vector lookup on 1-2 replica config; p95 <= 220ms.
- Data governance: encryption at rest (KMS), separate index per Redwood customer, audit logs for indexing/reads.
- Retention: ability to issue data deletion requests and confirm via audit log.
- Commercials: pilot at reduced rate (pilot credits) vs. list pricing; committed delta if we convert to a commercial plan.

Can you send a quick pricing attachment and confirm any constraints on cold-tier fallthrough to S3 (we plan to use S3 in us-west-2) plus lead time for provisioning? I attached a strawman pilot-scope doc to speed review.

Short timeline preference: contract redlines by Mar 24, kickoff April 1.

Thanks — Priya
-- 
Priya Natarajan
Head of Partnerships (Platform)
Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0129

Attachments: pilot-scope-v1.docx

From: Emma Li <emma@pinecone.io>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-03-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings storage & governance — pilot commercials and scope

Hi Priya —

Great to hear from you — happy to run the pilot with Redwood. Quick answers and requests: 

- Capacity: 50M vectors looks fine; we advise a single index with two replicas for the lookup SLA you called out.
- Cold-tier fallthrough: we support S3 cold-tiering in us-west-2; lifecycle policies are configurable but we do have a minimum object size for efficient retrieval — I included details in the attached pricing sheet.
- Governance & audit: we support KMS integration and per-index access logs; we can provide a daily audit dump for the pilot.
- Pricing: attaching pinecone-pilot-pricing.xlsx — pilot credit line proposed: $25k of usage credit, convert-to-commit discount if you convert within 60 days of pilot end.

Questions for you: do you need SOC2 evidence or a specific data residency attestation in writing for procurement? Also confirm your expected average QPS during peak for sizing.

I can loop in our legal ops for a light SOW + commercial redline. If the timeline is tight we can push kickoff to Apr 4 to ensure legal alignment.

Cheers,
Emma
Partner Solutions
Pinecone
emma@pinecone.io

Priya / Rafael —

Quick internal note after Emma's pricing:

- Pilot credit of $25k is reasonable but I recommend we ask for an additional month of operational support (1x engineer/week) to help with reindexing and integration.
- Ask for an SLA credit clause if p95 breaches > 2 events in the pilot window.
- Procurement will want SOC2 Type II evidence; Rafael, can we take a lightweight attestation instead of full SOC2 report during pilot?

Subject: Re: Embeddings storage & governance — pilot commercials and scope (commercial redlines)

Emma / Priya / Marissa —

Thanks — I reviewed Pinecone's pricing sheet. A few redlines from legal and procurement perspective (high level):

1) Data handling and deletion: we need a clause requiring written confirmation within 7 business days of a deletion request, plus a signed attestation that the deletion occurred in the index and in any cached backups used during the pilot.
2) Audit logs: include a daily audit dump and a promise to retain logs for 90 days; access by Redwood should be available via secure link.
3) Indemnity/limitations: standard mutual indemnity; remove unilateral IP assignment language.
4) SLA & credits: define p95 and p50 numerically and tie credits to measurable incidents; for pilot, make credits application to pilot credit bucket.

I attached a PDF with inline redlines: pinecone-commercial-redline.pdf. We are okay with the $25k pilot credit if Pinecone can commit to one week of engineering support during ramp.

Rafael Mendes
Head of Legal, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.ai

Attachment: pinecone-commercial-redline.pdf
